title: Implement target trust authorization contracts and consuming validation
goal: Provide base-held single-use target trust authorization generation and validation without applying or remotely activating a Target change.
acceptanceCriteria: Trusted base policy defines the protected set and candidate policy cannot authorize itself.
Authorization candidates bind a separate consuming Plan and exact add change or delete hashes.
Missing partial candidate-only reused mismatched self-authorizing and unprotected records fail closed.
Validation reports Host and policy judge identity.
No Target workflow ruleset pull request or remote state is changed.
risks: Candidate-controlled policy could authorize a changed judge.
Authorization validation could be confused with Target application or remote enforcement.
decisions: Read policy and consumed authorization from the exact trusted base Git object.
Expose validation evidence only and keep application and activation as separate transactions.
